tool.name: SminaRun
tool.description: : Wrapper of the smina molecular docking software.

param.name: input_ligands_sdf_path
param.label: input SDF file
param.help: Path to the input SDF ligands. Format: [input].sdf

param.name: input_receptor_pdbqt_path
param.label: input PDBQT file
param.help: Path to the input PDBQT receptor. Format: [input].pdbqt

param.name: input_site_coords_path
param.label: input YML,YAML file
param.help: Path to the yaml-file containing the binding site size and coordinates. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: outname_output_sdf_path
param.label: output SDF name
param.help: Path to the output SDF file Format: [output].sdf

param.name: outname_output_log_path
param.label: output LOG name
param.help: Path to the log file Format: [output].log

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: cpu
param.label: cpu
param.help: the number of CPUs to use.

param.name: exhaustiveness
param.label: exhaustiveness
param.help: exhaustiveness of the global search (roughly proportional to time).

param.name: num_modes
param.label: num_modes
param.help: maximum number of binding modes to generate.

param.name: energy_range
param.label: energy_range
param.help: maximum energy difference between the best binding mode and the worst one displayed (kcal/mol).

param.name: binary_path
param.label: binary_path
param.help: path to smina in your local computer.
